notes: Coming Up is now This Month: a ring shows how much you've logged against what your plan sends this month.
Paid as planned logs every payment your plan has left for the month in one tap. It shows the list first, you can untick or change any amount, and Undo takes it all back.
Swipe a payment right to log it. Swipe left to pay it on a later date or skip it this month. Tapping a payment opens the log form with the amount already filled in.
Each payment now shows what your plan sends to it, not just the minimum.

Payment reminders: add a repeating event for each due date to your phone's calendar, with an alert 1, 3 or 7 days before and on the day. Account names stay out of your calendar unless you choose to show them, and nothing is sent to us.
